events.name: Hackathon November 2026
events.description: A four-stage competition: register a team, develop your concept, submit a working project and compete for a place in the top-30 final.
stages: Register your team before the deadline.
Submit your idea through the signed-in workspace.
Selected participants submit their demo video.
Present your project in the virtual final.
Results are published in the workspace.
awards: Cash prize, trophy and hard-copy certificate
events.note: Prize amounts are stated as “up to” figures and are not guaranteed. Individual cash allocations are not published.

events.name: Prahar
events.description: A hackathon where students and professionals compete together. Submit your idea, build a working project and showcase your skills in the final competition.
stages: Submit the idea and proposed build plan.
events.note: The source lists both 12-hour and 24-hour final-round durations. Confirm the final duration with the organizers. Its detailed page does not confirm a registration deadline; 21 May 2027 is listed as the idea-submission date.
